## Checklist

- [ ] I've read the [contributing guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The skill is related to Medusa and targets Medusa v2.
- [ ] The skill is in a public repository with a README that explains how to install it.
- [ ] The skill has a `SKILL.md` file with a `name` and `description` in its frontmatter.
- [ ] The skill doesn't contain secrets or instructions unrelated to its stated purpose.
- [ ] I added the entry in alphabetical order using the [entry format](../CONTRIBUTING.md#entry-format).
- [ ] I tested the skill with at least one AI agent.
